description.content: Each user is a member of a single organization. These routes allow users to manage their organization. Most actions are only available to admin users.

Returns the current organization's Azure AD SSO configuration (sensitive
fields are not included).

Creates or updates the current organization's Azure AD SSO configuration.
Omit `oauth2ClientSecret` to preserve the previously stored secret on
updates.
Removes the current organization's Azure AD SSO configuration.

Returns the current organization's Okta SSO configuration (sensitive
fields are not included).

Creates or updates the current organization's Okta SSO configuration.
Omit `oauth2ClientSecret` to preserve the previously stored secret on
updates.
Removes the current organization's Okta SSO configuration.

Returns the current organization's generic OIDC SSO configuration
(sensitive fields are not included).

Creates or updates the current organization's generic OIDC SSO
configuration. Omit `clientSecret` to preserve the previously stored
secret on updates.
Removes the current organization's generic OIDC SSO configuration.

Returns the current organization's OneLogin SSO configuration (sensitive
fields are not included).

Creates or updates the current organization's OneLogin SSO
configuration. Omit `oauth2ClientSecret` to preserve the previously
stored secret on updates.
Removes the current organization's OneLogin SSO configuration.

Returns the current organization's Google SSO policy. Google is enabled
by default using the shared instance OAuth app; a configuration only
exists when the org has set an explicit policy (e.g. disabled Google).
`null` means no explicit policy — Google follows the instance default.

Creates or updates the current organization's Google SSO policy. Google
has no per-org credentials — only the `enabled` / domain / password
flags are stored.

Removes the current organization's Google SSO policy, reverting to the
instance default (Google enabled).
Lists the domains the current organization has verified ownership of.

Sends a one-time passcode to an address at the domain to begin verifying
ownership. The domain must not be a public email provider and must not
already be verified by another organization.

Confirms a domain verification passcode. On success the domain is marked
verified for the organization.

Removes a verified domain and strips it from any SSO provider that routed
to it.

Returns the current organization's settings. Defaults are returned when
no settings have been saved.

Updates the current organization's settings. Only the provided fields
are changed.
List all organization design assets.
Create a new organization design. Starts empty — upload files separately.
Get a single organization design with its files.
Update an organization design's name or description.
Delete an organization design and all its files (cascades S3).

Clear whichever design is currently the organization default. Idempotent
— succeeds when no default is set.

NOTE: This literal `/default` route MUST stay registered before
`Delete('/{designUuid}')` below so Express routes a request to
`DELETE /api/v1/org/designs/default` here rather than treating
"default" as a `designUuid` path param.
Mark this design as the organization's default. Clears any previous default.

Upload a file into a design. Send raw bytes as the body with the
appropriate Content-Type and Content-Length headers. Pass `kind`
and `filename` as query parameters. Mirrors the data-app image
upload pattern — no multipart wrapping required.
Delete a single file from an organization design.

Download a single file from an organization design. Streams the
S3 object body back with the stored Content-Type and a sensible
Content-Disposition.
Get the current user's organization

Creates a new organization, the current user becomes the Admin of the new organization.
This is only available to users that are not already in an organization.
Update the current user's organization
Deletes an organization and all users inside that organization

variable.description: (Required) the uuid of the organization to delete
(Required) the uuid of the organization to delete
(Required) the uuid of the organization to delete
